summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities of investment vehicles that offer exposure to the digital assets that comprise the CoinShares-Compass Crypto Market 35% Capped Index. The index is a diversified digital asset index which seeks to track the performance of the ten largest digital assets by market capitalization, weighted according to their market capitalization with a maximum weighting of 35%. The fund is non-diversified.
